hub.title: Moderation
hub.subtitle: Each filter is turned on separately and starts off. The streamer, Lead Moderators and moderators are never sanctioned.
hub.kickBody: Filters, mod commands and history work. Panic mode and the new-accounts filter are not available: the Kick API cannot change chat modes and does not report account age.
hub.loadFailed: Could not load the filter status
hub.kickRaids: Bot phrases that sell viewers (Kick has no panic mode or new-accounts filter)

banned_words.name: Banned words
banned_words.description: Words and phrases that cannot be used in chat, each with its severity

links.name: Links
links.description: Blocks links in chat, including disguised ones, except the domains you allow or with !permit

spam.name: Spam
spam.description: Caps, symbols, emotes, long or repeated messages, copypasta, zalgo and mentions

raids.name: Raids and bots
raids.description: Panic mode (!panico), new accounts and bot phrases that sell viewers

commands.name: Mod commands
commands.description: !permit, !strikes, !nuke, !panico and more: who can use each one

bots.name: Bot list
bots.description: Nightbot, StreamElements and other bots: they do not count as people, trigger commands or show in the chat overlay

history.name: History
history.description: Who was sanctioned, why and by whom; undo timeouts, bans and strikes

commands.title: Moderation commands
commands.subtitle: Choose who can use each command. Anyone with full control of the channel in the dashboard counts as the streamer. The bot ignores everyone else.

items.permit: Lets a user's links through. The duration is set in the links filter.
items.strikes: Shows which strike a user is on and when the next one drops.
items.words: Adds or removes banned words from chat. Without a severity, it is added as mild.
items.links: Adds or removes allowed domains of the links filter.
items.panic: Turns panic mode on (or extends it if already on) and off. What it does is set in Raids and bots. !pánico and !panic also work. Not available on Kick.
items.nuke: Sanctions everyone who wrote that phrase in the last seconds. It does not touch the streamer, mods or the whitelist.

links.title: Links filter
links.subtitle: With the filter on, no link gets through except the domains you allow here or someone with a !permit.
links.offNotice: The filter is off: links currently get through unchecked.
links.domainError: That does not look like a domain. Example: youtube.com

allowed.title: Allowed domains
allowed.hint: Includes subdomains: allowing youtube.com also lets m.youtube.com through.
allowed.none: No allowed domains: with the filter on, all links are blocked.

who.title: Who can send links
who.hint: The streamer, Lead Moderators, moderators, the whitelist and anyone with full control of the channel always can.

obf.title: Disguised links
obf.hint: Spammers write the link split up so it is not detected.
obf.label: Detect site . com, site(dot)com, site[.]com and site dot com

permit.title: !permit command
permit.hint: !permit @user lets their links through. Moderators, Lead Moderators, the streamer and anyone with full control of the channel can use it.
permit.oneMessage: A single message with a link

sanction.title: Sanction
sanction.hint: A blocked link is always deleted, even if the strike only calls for a warning. The strike scale, its expiry and the whitelist are the same as Banned words.
sanction.messageHint: Empty = the message above. Variables: $(user), $(strike), $(word) (the domain).

test.title: Test a message
test.hint: Uses the saved settings; if you changed something, save before testing.
test.placeholder: check out my channel at site . com
test.actionNormal: Action for a viewer with no strikes: {{action}}
test.offWarn: That filter is off: this message would currently pass without a sanction.
test.passes: The message passes: it has no blocked links.

spam.title: Spam filters
spam.subtitle: Each filter starts off and is turned on separately. They use the same strike scale and whitelist as Banned words.
spam.someFailed: Some filters could not be saved
spam.footer: Switches save instantly. Empty message = the example message. Variables: $(user), $(strike), $(word).

caps.name: Caps
caps.description: Messages written almost entirely in capitals.

minLetters.label: Only in messages with at least
minLetters.help: So a "GG" or an "XD" does not count.

caps.note: Twitch emotes do not count as capitals. 7TV, BTTV and FFZ ones do, because they arrive as text.

symbols.name: Symbols
symbols.description: Messages full of signs or ASCII art (▀▄█).

minLength.label: Only in messages with at least

emotes.name: Emotes
emotes.description: Too many emotes in a single message.
emotes.note: Counts Twitch emotes. 7TV, BTTV and FFZ ones cannot be counted.

length.name: Long messages
length.description: Messages longer than a certain length.

repetition.name: Repeated messages
repetition.description: The same user sending the same message several times.

copypasta.name: Copypasta
copypasta.description: Many different users pasting the same text.

minLength.label: Only texts of at least
minLength.help: So a "GG" or an emote the whole chat repeats does not count.

copypasta.note: Sanctions start at the user who reaches the number; the earlier ones are not sanctioned.

zalgo.name: Zalgo and odd text
zalgo.description: Zalgo text (letters with marks above and below that cover the chat).

maxCombiningMarks.label: Consecutive marks allowed
maxCombiningMarks.help: Languages such as Vietnamese use 1 or 2.

zalgo.note: Zalgo text is always deleted, even if the strike only calls for a warning.

mentions.name: Mentions
mentions.description: Too many @mentions of different users in one message.

raids.title: Hate raids and bots
raids.subtitle: Panic mode to lock the chat in seconds, a new-accounts filter and bot phrases that sell viewers.
raids.kickBody: Only the bot phrases filter works here. Panic mode and the new-accounts filter are not available: the Kick API cannot change chat modes and does not report account age.
raids.phraseTooShort: The phrase is too short: without spaces or symbols it needs at least 8 letters or numbers
raids.panicEnds: {{reason}} · turns off by itself in {{min}} min
raids.panicHow: It can also be turned on with !panico in chat and off with !panico off.

what.title: What panic does
what.hint: When it ends, the chat goes back exactly as it was.
what.chatModesHint: You choose which restrictions the bot applies.
what.shieldHint: Applies what you configured in Twitch's moderation tools.
what.announce: Announce in chat when it starts and ends

auto.title: Automatic activation
auto.hint: Off by default. If you turn it on, the bot starts panic mode by itself when it detects a wave.
auto.newAccounts: New accounts writing at once (hate raid)

age.title: New accounts
age.hint: Sanctions newly created accounts that write. Their message is always deleted.
age.onlyPanic: Only while panic mode is on

bots.title: Bot phrases
bots.hint: Spam from bots that sell viewers and followers. Detected even when written split up or with symbols.
bots.toggle: Turn on the bot phrases filter

raids.footer: The panic button and the switches apply instantly; everything else when you save.

history.title: Moderation history
history.subtitle: Who was sanctioned, why and by whom. You can lift a timeout or a ban and give the strike back.

undo.title: Undo sanction
undo.qBanStrike: Lift the ban on {{user}} and give the strike back?
undo.qTimeoutStrike: Lift the timeout on {{user}} and give the strike back?
undo.deletedNote: The deleted message cannot be recovered.
undo.noStrikes: it no longer had strikes to give back

banned.title: Banned Words
banned.subtitle: Complete moderation system for banned words and phrases
banned.toggleLabel: Turn on the banned words filter
banned.offNotice: The filter is off: the bot does not sanction any word on the list until you turn it on.

add.title: Add Banned Word
add.tip: Tip: use asterisks (*) as wildcards. Example: *spam* matches "spam", "spammer", "antispam"

immunity.title: Immunity System
immunity.alwaysBody: They ALWAYS have full immunity. So does anyone with full control of the channel in the dashboard, even if they are a viewer in chat.

whitelist.title: Manual Whitelist
whitelist.note: Users on the whitelist ALWAYS have full immunity

messages.title: Custom Messages per Action
messages.severoNote: This message is used when a word with "Severe" severity is detected (direct ban, no strikes)

strikes.title: Strike Escalation System
strikes.expirationHint: Strikes drop 1 level after the configured time without infractions
